verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Realtime is documented as API-first: the SFU is controlled over standard HTTPS APIs, DataChannel permissions have dedicated endpoints, and the Core SDK lets you build every screen and interaction yourself instead of using the prebuilt UI. An OpenAPI document is also reachable. However, nothing in the evidence states or shows that every dashboard or prebuilt-UI action has an API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that dashboard management tasks (app creation, analytics, recording/config settings) are API-accessible, an OpenAPI spec confirmed to cover Realtime endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Realtime SFU API to control which endpoints publish or receive audio, video, and data.
